description: Members BaneCounter patches. Harmony binds by name at runtime, so a rename in a game update would otherwise be a silent no-op. Bane is called Curse throughout the assembly; only localization says 'Bane'.

properties.name: ViewValue
properties.why: postfixed to CurseLevel; vanilla reports CursesPower.Count, a 1-5 tier count

properties.name: BlinkOnChange
properties.why: optionally silenced, since the value now changes on every Pact cast

properties.name: Show
properties.why: gates the icon on CursesPower.Count > 0; unpatched, but the mod depends on it being true whenever CurseLevel > 0

fields.name: _creature
fields.why: reached by FieldRefAccess to find the Mercenary behind the effect

fields.name: CurseLevel
fields.why: the number the whole mod exists to display

fields.name: CursesPower
fields.why: vanilla's ViewValue source; its Count is what the icon showed before

properties.name: ActivationLevel
properties.why: the thresholds - 1, 200, 400, 700, 1000 - the tooltip counts toward

methods.name: InitTooltip
methods.why: postfixed to append the level rows under vanilla's curse list

fields.name: _effectWithViews
fields.why: identifies which effect the hovered panel is showing

fields.name: _createdTooltip
fields.why: proves vanilla built a tooltip to append to

methods.name: AddPanelToTooltip
methods.why: appends a row to the tooltip currently being built

methods.name: BuildMercenaryTooltip
methods.why: postfixed to add Bane rows to the operator tooltip

methods.name: Initialize
methods.why: postfixed to attach and refresh the roster Bane icon

fields.name: _implantsIcon
fields.why: cloned as the Bane diamond so the new icon inherits prefab layout

fields.name: _mercClass
fields.why: font donor for the roster number; avoids shipping a font asset

fields.name: _icon
fields.why: the sprite swapped to the curse icon on the clone

fields.name: _selectionBorder
fields.why: hidden on the clone; it is a hover affordance for a control the clone is not

fields.name: CurseData
fields.why: per-operator Bane, read on the roster where no Player exists yet
